verdict.rationale: Retell stores per-call transcripts and recordings, as its per-agent data retention controls show. Programmatic access is implied by SDKs with 'full voice and chat endpoint coverage' and by call_ended/call_analyzed webhooks pushed to your server, and Conductor can inspect transcripts. However, no evidence shows a get-call/list-calls endpoint or webhook payload that actually returns the recording URL and full transcript. Missing for 10: explicit API docs for retrieving the recording and transcript per call, webhook payload contents showing recording/transcript fields, and independent hands-on corroboration.
